senses.gloss: Dṛḍha^1, son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 137, 5644 (among seven sons of Dhṛtarāshṭra, who are slain by Bhīmasena); 157, 6938 (the same?, among ten sons of Dhṛtarāshṭra who attacked Bhīmasena). Cf. Dṛḍhahasta, Dṛḍhakshatra, Dṛḍhasandha, Dṛḍhavarman, Dṛḍhāyudha.
Dṛḍha^2 = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Dṛḍhāśva, son of Kuvalāśva. § 478 (Dhundhumārop.): III, 200, 13621.
Dṛḍhadhanvan, a prince. § 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6995 (Pauravaḥ?, present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).
Dṛḍhahasta, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2737.--§ 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4549. Cf. Dṛḍha^1.
Dṛḍhakshatra, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2734.--§ 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4547. Cf. Dṛḍha{??}.

Dṛḍharatha^1, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2739.--§ 600 (Ghaṭotkacavadhap.): VII, 152, 6851 (the same?, follows Śakuni); 157, 6938 (among seven sons of Dhṛtarāshṭra who attacked Bhīmasena). Cf. Dṛḍharathāśraya.
Dṛḍharatha^2, an ancient king. § 775 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 166, 7678.
Dṛḍharathāśraya, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4551. Cf. Dṛḍharatha^1.
Dṛḍhasandha, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2735.--§ 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4548. Cf. Dṛḍha^1.
Dṛḍhasena, a Pāṇḍava warrior. § 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 21, 906 (slain by Droṇa).
Dṛḍhasyu, a ṛshi, son of Agastya and Lopāmudrā. § 382 (Agastyop.): III, 99, 8640 (called Idhmavāha).
Dṛḍhavarman, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2734.--§ 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4547. Cf. Dṛḍha^1.
Dṛḍhavrata, a ṛshi. § 665 (Mokshadh.): XII, 208, 7595 (one of the ṛshis of the south). Cf. Dṛḍhavya, Dṛḍhāyu^3.
Dṛḍhavya, a ṛshi. § 770 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 151, 7112 (one of the seven Dharmarājartvijaḥ in the south). Cf. Dṛḍhavrata, Dṛḍhāyu^2.
Dṛḍhāyu(s)^2, a king. § 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 86 (among the princes to whom the Pāṇḍavas ought to send messengers).
Dṛḍhāyu(s)^3, a ṛshi. § 775 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 166, 7666 (one of the ṛshis of the south). Cf. Dṛḍhavrata, Dṛḍhavya.
Dṛḍhāyudha, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2734. Cf. Dṛḍha^1.
Dṛḍheshudhi, an ancient king. § 6 (Anukram.): I, 1, 231 (in Sañjaya's enumeration of departed kings).
Dṛḍheyu, a ṛshi. § 770 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 151, 7114 (one of the seven ṛtvijaḥ of Varuṇa, in the west).
